components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#006B76; color:#fff; padding:11px 18px; border:0; border-radius:7px; font:600 14px Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#005760; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #00464F; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supports a primary task without competing with it.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:#FFFFFF; color:#142F40; padding:10px 15px; border:0; border-radius:7px; font:400 14px Inter, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#E8F1F5; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #006B76; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Light navigation rail with an icon-only compact layout.
components.html: <nav class="ds-rail"><button class="ds-nav-active">GitHub Actions overview</button><button class="ds-nav">Create sign-in state</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-rail { width:208px; padding:12px; background:#F9FCFD; font-family:Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-nav,.ds-nav-active { display:block; width:100%; padding:11px 13px; border:0; border-radius:8px; text-align:left; font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-nav { color:#4B6575; background:transparent; } .ds-nav:hover { background:#E8F1F5; color:#006B76; } .ds-nav-active { color:#006B76; background:#DEF3F3; font-weight:600; } .ds-nav:focus-visible,.ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #00464F; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Task Surface
components.description: White task container on quiet paper, grouped without shadows.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:20px; border-radius:10px; background:#fff; color:#142F40; font:14px Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { display:block; font-size:20px; font-weight:600; } .ds-card p { margin:6px 0 0; color:#4B6575; }

components.name: Local Status Panel
components.description: Low-emphasis panel for directly observed local readiness or status.
components.css: .ds-status { padding:10px 13px; border-radius:8px; background:#F2F7FA; color:#4B6575; font:14px Inter, sans-serif; }

components.name: Secret Identifier
components.description: Machine-readable GitHub Secret name, visually separated from prose.
components.css: .ds-secret { display:inline-block; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:7px; background:#DEF3F3; color:#005760; font:14px Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview: A light desktop console for checking the daily schedule, reading account results and transferring local sign-in state to GitHub Actions.
keyCharacteristics: A light rail collapses to named icons at compact widths.
The 24-hour trace marks the three scheduled start windows in Taipei time.
Written statuses distinguish local readiness from completed remote results.

rules.name: Evidence Before Accent
rules.body: Teal signals a real local action or a directly observed readiness value. Do not use it to imply that a remote GitHub workflow has succeeded.

rules.name: Explain, Then Act
rules.body: A task card gives a short explanation before its command, so the user knows whether it opens a browser, copies local state, or requires manual verification.

rules.name: Tonal Depth
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with surface color and spacing, never with decorative drop shadows or glass effects.

dos: Use the 208-unit light rail on wide windows and a 72-unit icon rail at compact widths.
Do surface account isolation and local readiness clearly, including the 1–33 account range and scrollable status list.
Use deep teal for primary commands, selected navigation and the schedule trace.
Do lead every browser/login handoff with concise copy that tells the user what will happen and what remains manual.
donts: Don't represent GitHub Actions or a remote check-in as successful without a direct result the app has actually observed.
Don't add password collection, CAPTCHA bypass, OTP automation, or copy that suggests the app performs those tasks.
Keep the schedule diagram tied to the configured hours.
Don't turn the four task destinations into oversized cards or hide safety guidance behind secondary navigation.
